profile_text.body:
Netflix is a publicly traded entertainment company headquartered in Los Gatos, California, listed under the ticker NFLX. Its own profile describes it as one of the world's leading entertainment services, offering TV series, films, games and live programming across a range of genres and languages. The company says members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime and anywhere, and can change their plans at any time. It reports over 260 million paid memberships in over 190 countries.

The profile text harvested from the company's site does not describe AI-specific products or services, and no AI products are listed among the facts held about the company. The company is recorded as a for-profit public company with CIK 0001065280. Its recorded litigation exposure is concentrated in California, with 281 matters.
